payload.name: Failure mode in I-1795493412-ledger-temp-worktree-cleanup/P-1795493432-CLA-CF5.2/E-1795505480-CLA-CF5.2/_
payload.description: Reproduced failure across 4 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 1 finding detected: FIND-R1-001-01
symptoms: A `git worktree add` killed mid-checkout (timeout or host kill) leaves a `locked initializing` registration: single-force removal is refused, prune skips locked entries and the sweep excludes `locked`, so it is never cleared (reproduced on git 2.47.3). Use `--force --force` and let the sweep clear unowned `initializing` ledger worktrees.
